required_outputs: real META-AUTONOMY-01 trace overlay with observed vs inferred timing kept distinct
static candidate HTML showing Surface|Book|Flow|Trace for this worker object
book/Engineering Memory candidate section explaining origins, capabilities, decisions, failures and validators
proposal for generation/parity test so Flow cannot drift from executable rules
speed_laws: No remote read/write per graph node.
Compile graph once from exact sources.
Use local in-memory trace events while generating the canary.
forbidden: hand-author claims that conflict with executable contracts
success: all graph branches terminate or enter bounded loop
no protected side effect reachable without authority edge
real trace overlays the graph without redefining truth
visual canary is inspectable and source-linked
